proposal.why: Pilot's call 2026-09-11: Gleaming Splendor for Alhammarret's Archive. The instrument cannot see it — Forge at 40 games (MDE 0.34, delta -0.028, CI [-0.23, +0.19]) and a goldfish that does not read the second-draw Treasure trigger — so the decision is on theory: a Treasure per opponent per turn in a deck that makes every opponent draw every turn, and it stacks with Smothering Tithe. The Archive's lifegain half was off-plan. One to buy.
